scope: First public Carryforth Desktop, Local Relay OCI image, and cf CLI release surface

filesystem_assets.provenance: Created in Carryforth commit 8d02a4750e5cf0ac690ffe712341217f1994b063. The SVG names Inter as a rendering preference but does not embed a font file.

filesystem_assets.classification: Carryforth project artwork and generated renditions
filesystem_assets.provenance: The preferred source is desktop/src-tauri/icons/carryforth-source.svg, created in Carryforth commit 8d02a4750e5cf0ac690ffe712341217f1994b063. The PNG, ICO, ICNS, Android, and iOS files in this tree are generated renditions of that source.

Generated entirely from the procedural SVG recipe in desktop/scripts/texture-card/generate-card-texture.mjs, introduced with the output in upstream Apache-2.0 commit 7873135a0bf843116102796a1671bb4141c4ed23. No external source image is read by the generator.

Byte-identical copies of poof1@3x.png through poof5@3x.png and Example/Pow Example/Sounds/plop.m4a from EmergeTools/Pow commit 1b4b1dda28c50b95f0872927ee2226fe8b58950e. desktop/public/pow/LICENSE.txt contains the Emerge Tools MIT license and is delivered beside the assets. Introduced upstream in commit d4cd919b8506469f0bfd68100f13cdf16d3e76bc.

filesystem_assets.classification: Original generated PCM audio and waveform renditions
filesystem_assets.provenance: All twelve mono 48 kHz 16-bit little-endian WAV files and twelve PCM-derived SVG waveforms are deterministically generated by desktop/scripts/generate-notification-sounds.mjs. The fixed-point generator reads no legacy audio, sample pack, network resource, or system font and is verified byte-for-byte by its --check mode.

font_dependencies.classification: Third-party font dependency emitted into the Vite bundle
font_dependencies.provenance: desktop/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml resolve @fontsource-variable/inter 5.2.8. Its package LICENSE identifies Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors and the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
font_dependencies.blocker: The OFL copyright and license text are not yet staged into the installed Desktop package or a bundled third-party notice artifact.

release_obligations.description: The project programs are Apache-2.0, but their resolved Cargo, pnpm, native/system, and AppImage dependency closures still need a generated license report and tag-bound SBOM included with the release. The Rust dependency closure also needs a locked RustSec audit with archived tag-bound evidence. Package-level Apache metadata alone is not a license inventory or vulnerability gate for the linked binaries.

Dockerfile currently resolves rust:1.95-bookworm and debian:bookworm-slim by mutable tags and installs unversioned apt packages. Pin release base images by digest and emit the final OCI package/SBOM inventory before publication. The build-only Rust image also needs provenance even though it is not shipped as a layer.

The Tauri bundle still uses the legacy xyz.block.buzz.app identifier to protect existing local identity and app data. Public Desktop packages remain blocked until a Carryforth-owned reverse-DNS identifier and a fail-closed copy/readback migration preserve keyring identity, Community, messages, Agents, Project revisions, Documents, Context, and Meetings without cleaning the legacy store.

The published local bootstrap must use the initialized Community Owner identity to idempotently enable and canonically read back the Project View v3, Project Document, Project Context Edge, and Meeting capabilities. A development database that was bootstrapped by hand is not release evidence.

Human maintainers must freeze an immutable supported upgrade baseline. The published upgrade path must run against a recoverable copy of that baseline and prove before/after equality for identity, Community, messages, managed Agents, schema and migration state, Project revisions, Documents, Context Edges, and Meeting history without deleting or rewriting the source data.

A clean machine with no Block access, repository checkout, pre-existing app data, or private credentials must install only the published Desktop, Relay, cf, and local-stack artifacts; initialize an Owner Community; exercise messages, a managed Agent, Project View, Documents, Project Context, and a naturally completed 4-6-round Meeting; restart and read the state back; and repeat with legacy service domains blocked.

Human maintainers must publish stable private security and conduct-reporting routes and record the release governance decisions that implementation agents cannot invent: accountable maintainers, official artifact namespace and retention, supported platforms, signing identities and custodians, key rotation and loss handling, and the immutable upgrade baseline.
